properties.name: __Phase0EnabledRole
properties.generatedExpression: CASE WHEN Enabled = 1 AND IsDeleted = 0 THEN Role ELSE NULL END

properties.name: __Phase0ActiveKey
properties.generatedExpression: CASE WHEN IsDeleted = 0 THEN `Key` ELSE NULL END

policy.fullLengthIndexes: No prefix indexes, shortened key lengths or changed nullability. Failure is a feasibility finding.
policy.conditionalUniqueness: Two nullable STORED generated columns preserve active-product/enabled-role uniqueness; nullable Triage idempotency uses native multi-NULL unique semantics. Must prove valid duplicates and invalid duplicates through actual SQL.
policy.dateRepresentation: Invariant O text, exact ticks, offset and DateTime Kind. Native datetime(6) cannot discharge the seven-digit fixture.
policy.nameMapping: Names at most64 unchanged; longer names use first47 + underscore + first16 uppercase SHA256 hex. Full names are never silently truncated.
policy.normalization: Physical adapters normalize SQL type aliases, quoted identifiers, default literals and generated-expression tokens only. Preserve exact semantic values, ordered vectors and full inventories.
policy.scope: Disposable full standalone McpDbContext compatibility experiment; not enrolled-project classification or an adopted production schema
